interpretation.positive: Genuine source-trained causal-rule experts were preserved, and CKAD43 beat original native on pooled late adaptation for both DEV seeds.
interpretation.negative: Both development seeds failed the preregistered superiority margin vs the independently source-trained causal_discount93/dual comparator. Seed 43111 early-return loss 0.18978 exceeds original native 0.12435 by about 0.06543, violating the +0.005 cap. Seed 43112 late-return candidate loss 0.15143 vs native 0.14909 misses 0.02 native improvement.
interpretation.routed_source_clue: Seed 43111/world0 B anomaly trigger at source event 54 was 50 events BEFORE the true evaluator-only first B event at 104, causing premature B allocation and repeated A/B switches. This true boundary was never provided to the learner and is post-run diagnostic only.
interpretation.second_clue: Seed 43112/world1 returned to A at episode 162, switched candidate to A at 174, then back to B at 218 despite the public environment still being A, showing late false return-to-B routing.
interpretation.conclusion: A second persistent learned causal specialist by itself does not reliably improve cold return-to-old-rule learning beyond a strong adaptive single causal template; mechanism needs better evidence calibration and independent unfamiliar-world qualification, not more snapshots.

limits: Source-generated stochastic environments are reused from CKAD39 family; not genuinely unfamiliar causal structures or real-world knowledge.
Original native remains unchanged and learning continues within a research sidecar; accepted autonomous Yggdrasil training not proven.
Two experts and extra control readouts are higher-cost than single native; recorded per-seed wall/CPU are whole-process and not matched-compute.
All original pilot/primary cohorts remain unconsumed. Repeating 43111/43112 after seeing outcomes would not be confirmatory independent science.
Full required-platform final regression, scientific owner first-use, independent transfer, accepted main integration, Forge loop, controller and deployment are unperformed.
Unrelated automatic CKB proxy fanout failure is separate infrastructure; it is not a scientific failure or success for CKAD43.
next_executable_research: Stop CKAD43. A new independently frozen causal-change identification candidate should be compared against the strong single discounted causal template, a matched trained conventional online change-point model and oracle-labeled ceiling, with fresh disjoint seeds and unknown action-identity transfer; do not retune or replay this frozen DEV cohort.
